sources.caption: Celebrating our brilliant champions! Extraordinary performance in JEE Advanced and NEET-UG. Hard work, daily error analysis, and supreme dedication always bear fruit. Proud of every single scholar at Balaji and Yashoda Bhavans! #OxfordVIT #IITJEE #NEET #Narasaraopet #Champions

sources.achievementDetails: AIR 48 in JEE Advanced (K. Vamsi Krishna) and 692/720 in NEET-UG (P. Sai Meghana).

sources.caption: Mathematics is not about memorizing steps; it is about cultivating intuition. In our Super-60 classes at Balaji Bhavan, every problem is a gateway to deeper geometric and algebraic insight. 100 days to JEE Main — focus on error logs every single evening.
sources.mediaDescription: Text briefing and conceptual blackboard diagram illustrating coordinate geometry locus transformations.
sources.achievementDetails: Pedagogical insight behind consecutive years of 99.8+ percentile in JEE Main Mathematics.
sources.verificationStatus: Verified - Verified Management Profile (@raghava_vit on Threads)

sources.caption: Discipline in residential life is what converts potential into national achievement. At Yashoda Bhavan, safety, peace, and uninterrupted study hours give our girl scholars the confidence to conquer AIIMS and top medical colleges.
sources.mediaDescription: Institutional briefing discussing security protocols, female warden supervision, and quiet study alcoves.
sources.achievementDetails: Over 500+ successful MBBS admissions from Oxford VIT medical division.
